title: Rigid Body Drop Lab
teaches: Use one RigidBody tag with an explicit 3D dimension and body type.
Build an arena from static colliders and an authored kinematic collider.
Let eight differently proportioned dynamic Models form a dense pile-up, collide, spin, bounce and settle under shared Scene gravity.
Compare mass, friction, rolling friction, restitution and inertia without competing animation transforms.
Require sustained low linear and angular velocity before a supported body sleeps.
Enable continuousCollision for fast small bodies that would otherwise tunnel.
Derive analytic and convex primitive colliders from typed geometry with shape=auto and inspect them through PhysicsDebug.
